name: Screen Studio
soft_passes: #2 grid: optical centering good, vertical center dead-on; horizontal centroid pulled left is a brightness artifact, not a real offset; ring outer diameter ~78% of canvas (large-ish); true grid unverifiable at 102px
#3 silhouette: a ring is instantly nameable but generic (target/lens/spinner/O); subject-communication rests on color+context, distinctiveness carried by the neon-void treatment not the outline
#5 single light model: bg is top-lit while the ring's shading is brightest lower-left; passes only under the self-luminous/emissive exemption (the ring is a light source)
#8 depth: bloom/glow is baked in (HIG says let the system apply glows) but it is systematic+purposeful+accessible, so recorded as a signature move not a defect
#10 variant robustness: ring silhouette survives dark/clear/tinted, but identity is color-bound (tinted mono keeps the O, loses the neon soul); no evidence of authored Default/Dark/Mono variants

palette.background: ramp #1F1340->#070310 (dark indigo top to near-black bottom)

light_model: Two-part: near-black squircle ground lit top-down (lighter indigo up top, near-black at bottom); the violet ring is emissive/self-luminous with a soft radial bloom behind it and a faintly-lit central aperture; no hard cast shadow.
layer_stack: near-black squircle with vertical indigo->black ramp
devices: luminous record-ring on a void (self-illuminated violet torus, subject-mined record 'O'/lens aperture)
monochrome-purple discipline (ground+glow+glyph all one hue at different values)
emissive-over-lit (glyph emits its own light rather than reflecting a top-down source)
rhymes_hint: neon-glyph-on-void family: dark near-black squircle + one glowing brand mark in a single saturated hue, emissive with soft bloom (dark creative/AI/recording pro-tool icons); not yet a promoted icon cluster
notes: Source is a 102x102px web render (icon.webp, SHA-1 a7bf5c48), NOT a 1024 master — grid alignment, any Liquid Glass refraction/specular, and micro-shadow detail are estimated, not measured. Era called big-sur for the unified-squircle grammar (front-facing, single centered glyph, soft top-lit ground), but it is a committed dark-luminous/neon-bloom variant that departs from Big Sur's soft-lit-surface-object+tool-overlay convention and leans toward custom. Could be a Liquid Glass DARK render, but the low-res source shows no confirmable glass edge highlights/refraction/tinted-layer evidence, so liquid-glass is unproven and not claimed. Brand-context coherence is strong: the same purple ring appears as the cover wordmark logo and the in-app sidebar mark, so the icon reads as brand primitive, not decoration. Vertical ring center dead-on (50.1/51); outer ring diameter ~78% of canvas width.
